verdict.rationale: Datalab documents a 400 req/min rate limit on the Team plan and a limits page that advises using page_range for oversized documents. Webhooks support async job completion without polling, and on-prem Enterprise deployments are explicitly aimed at 'extremely high volume' workloads. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk submission API for millions of pages, published throughput or latency guarantees (predictable pages/sec or SLA), full per-plan rate-limit details beyond the Team tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration of large-scale performance.
